heading: INT. ABANDONED NURSERY SCHOOL, CLASSROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ABANDONED NURSERY SCHOOL, CLASSROOM - NIGHT
Tiny chairs.
A rocking horse with no eyes.
Peeling alphabet posters in the moonlight.
A music box plays three notes and stops.
OFFICER DWIGHT MALLORY, forties, flashlight in hand, nudges open the door with his boot.
His partner OFFICER SANDRA PELL, thirties, follows, gun low.
A teenage urban explorer, TAYLOR REEVES, seventeen, trails behind with a camera, whispering.
And at the back wall, so still she could be a coat on a hook, stands a girl in a yellow dress, MISS MARIGOLD, her face turned to the corner.
Police. Anyone in here?
units.name: MALLORY

units.text: Quiet. Listen.
units.name: PELL

units.text: It's just the wind, right?
units.name: TAYLOR

units.text: The music box plays again.
Pell sweeps her light.
Mallory crouches by the rocking horse and puts a hand on its empty socket.
Taylor lifts the camera, the red light blinks, and the flashlight beam crosses the yellow dress.
Dwight.
units.name: PELL

units.text: I see her.
units.name: MALLORY

units.text: Is that, is she a kid?
units.name: TAYLOR

units.text: The girl turns.
Her face is smooth and pale as a plate.
She lifts one hand to her mouth, and the music box plays its three notes again.
Nap time.
units.name: MARIGOLD
